content.definition: Obligation to clean up contamination (hazardous substances, pollution) at site where entity operates or operated
content.measurement: Best estimate of costs to be incurred. If range with no best estimate, use minimum of range.

types_of_costs.incremental_direct_costs: Costs directly related to remediation (testing, cleanup, disposal, monitoring)
types_of_costs.compensation_recovery: If recovery from insurance/third parties probable, recognize receivable separately (don't offset against liability)

recognition_triggers: Entity identified as potentially responsible party (PRP)

discount_to_present_value.if_timing_reliable: May discount to PV if timing and amount of cash flows reliable
discount_to_present_value.typically_not_discounted: Often timing uncertain, so not discounted (use nominal amounts)

accounting_entries.initial_recognition: DR Loss/Expense (or Asset if improves property), CR Environmental Liability

capitalize_vs_expense.expense: If remediation to restore to pre-contamination state or comply with law
capitalize_vs_expense.capitalize: If remediation improves property beyond original condition or extends life

accounting_entries.recovery: DR Receivable (if probable), CR Recovery/Gain (if recovery probable and separate from liability)

example.scenario: Company notified it is PRP for contaminated site. Estimated cleanup costs $2M. Insurance recovery $500K probable.
entries: DR Environmental Remediation Expense $2M, CR Environmental Liability $2M
DR Insurance Recovery Receivable $500K, CR Recovery Income $500K (or reduce expense)

superfund_sites.cercla: Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (federal law)
superfund_sites.joint_and_several_liability: All PRPs can be held liable for entire cleanup (not just their share)
superfund_sites.accounting: Accrue entity's best estimate of share, consider likelihood others will pay their share

disclosure_requirements: Possible loss if accrued amount less than reasonably possible
content.changes_in_estimates: Adjust liability and recognize gain/loss as new information available
cpa_exam_tips: Best estimate of costs (minimum of range if no best estimate)
Recovery from insurance: Separate receivable (don't offset against liability)
Joint and several liability: Accrue entity's best estimate

key_points: Environmental liability: Probable and estimable → Accrue
Best estimate of remediation costs (minimum of range if no best estimate)
Recovery: Separate receivable if probable (don't offset)
Superfund: Joint and several liability, accrue entity's share
Disclosure: Nature, amount, possible losses, recoveries
